title: Contacts
description: Callers recognised across calls, bookings and waitlists, with their consent and privacy history.
searchPlaceholder: Search by name, phone number or email
emptyDescription: Contacts appear automatically when callers reach your agents or book an appointment.
noMatchesDescription: Try a different name, phone number or email address.

profile.title: Profile
profile.memoryHint: Let agents greet this caller by name and reuse their preferences on later calls.

identities.title: Identifiers
identities.empty: No phone numbers or email addresses are linked.
identities.addDescription: Link a phone number, email address or external ID that belongs to this contact.
identities.removeDescription: {value} will no longer be matched to this contact on future calls.

hints.EMAIL: The address the contact uses to receive confirmations.
hints.EXTERNAL_ID: The identifier used for this person in your CRM or booking system.

merge.title: Merge duplicate contact
merge.description: Move all calls, bookings, identifiers and requests from this contact into another one. Consent records stay attached to the original history.
merge.noResults: No other contacts match this search.
merge.warning: This contact will be merged into {name}. The merge is recorded in the audit log and cannot be undone from the dashboard.

erasure.title: Record an erasure request
erasure.description: Personal data is deleted within 30 days unless a legal hold applies. Keep a note of how you verified the requester's identity.
erasure.verificationHint: For example: confirmed callback to the registered phone number.
erasure.onHold: Request recorded and paused by an active legal hold

calls.title: Recent calls
calls.empty: No calls with this contact yet.

waitlist.title: Waitlist
waitlist.empty: This contact is not on any waitlist.

consents.title: Consent history
consents.empty: No disclosures have been delivered to this contact.

privacy.title: Privacy requests
privacy.empty: No privacy requests for this contact.
